summary: Verified core testing principles: cross-service boundary protection (IDOR, open redirects, duplicate analytics), root causes of test flakiness (async races, non-deterministic state, uncleaned fixtures), and disaster prevention through strict database isolation.
evidence: Articulated what the integration suite protects against: IDOR data leaks, open redirects, duplicate analytics processing, cache inconsistencies, and retention compliance failures.
Defined test flakiness and identified primary root causes: race conditions, async message processing timing, shared state pollution, and arbitrary sleep delays.
Analyzed the catastrophic risks of unisolated tests hitting live databases: accidental data deletion, cache poisoning, external webhook triggering, and denial of service.
